scope: Investigate and fix repeated Weekly Rivalry artificial-driver restarts; test an isolated deployed-base candidate and perform the explicitly owner-authorized cloud worker rollout.

root_cause.mechanism: Synchronous drive_idle blocks the competition worker. BackgroundControl raises BackgroundYielded whenever an ordinary player run is ready. The generator kills its Godot process and deletes its temporary state; the waiting plan is unchanged, so the next idle pass starts the same earliest attempt from tick zero.
root_cause.secondary_fault: A controller timeout previously propagated without advancing or deferring the waiting attempt, allowing an indefinitely repeated failing head job.

implementation.RGP01: Long-running workers own at most one background drive. The foreground worker remains available to verify human races and explicit publications while that exact generation continues.
implementation.RGP02: The existing Godot generation child runs at Linux nice 19 or Windows below-normal priority. Its original finite time/output limits remain. Shutdown cancellation is checked before API operations, and the background task joins before shared resource disposal. Once-only/direct diagnostic calls keep their synchronous behavior.
implementation.RGP03: An automatic generation timeout defers only that attempt for 30/60 seconds, then marks it uncompleted after its third timeout. Other due attempts proceed. Durable batches use their existing bounded attempt budget for timeouts too.
implementation.observability: Stable derived generation IDs and elapsed seconds are recorded without replay data, names or tokens.
implementation.boundaries: Canonical input generation, physics/compiler/rules keys, five laps, ordinary authoritative tickets/uploads/verification, idempotent upload recovery, current-week/build selection, test-driver gates, public isolation and original plan/cache formats remain.
implementation.resources: One additional Python thread in the existing worker, at most one generator child. No extra cloud instance, service, dependency or persistent cache.

original_reproduction.detail: The real service/HTTP regression detects cancellation on the first human submission with the task-original source. Original initial fixture used an invalid 10ms worker interval; the valid production contract correction retained the assertions.

windows_focused.detail: Five ordinarily submitted player results verify while a single held AI generation survives and later verifies. Shutdown cancels owned work; a real publication completes without cancellation; timeout retries stop and other jobs advance; actual child cancellation/priority and no-late-upload are checked.

windows_native.detail: Standalone pinned Godot 4.7.2: exact cold/background recordings during foreground verification, existing full HTTP automatic generation/verification/upload recovery, and exact cached/regenerated oval proofs.

windows_broader.failures: Both publication supervisor role-list assertions expect no discovery child. Concurrent service_worker.py adds that child. Both identical failures reproduce when all task-original modules are restored through an isolated import overlay; no assertion was changed.

linux_current_workspace.detail: Linux priority, process reaping, bounded timeout scheduling and cancellation-before-upload passed. Full app fixtures hit the concurrently added 0051 telemetry migration empty DEFAULT syntax error. No migration was changed for this task.

release_candidate.detail: Exact deployed base plus nine-file fix overlay, at one CPU/1GiB with no external network. Seven focused checks plus native exact-recording concurrency and ordinary HTTP automatic-driver verification/recovery pass. Production dependencies are retained; only pytest/HTTP test support is isolated in the test image.

release.scope: Apply only this runtime patch to the exact retained deployed image; do not include local queue/reward/histogram/telemetry/discovery/geometry changes or migrations.
release.rollout_requires: Owner authorization satisfied by yes, deploy. Actual image, revision, preservation and progress evidence in rollout-receipt.json.
